d: Arkan Marketing Services is looking for a Marketing Specialist to strengthen the brand presence and marketing execution of an established fashion e-commerce business.

You will help shape how the brand looks, sounds, and connects with customers across its marketing channels. This role combines brand communication, content planning, creative coordination, and performance analysis, with responsibility for turning ideas into completed work.
We are looking for someone with strong fashion awareness, excellent communication skills and the attention to detail to deliver consistent, effective marketing.
q: li
3–5 years of practical marketing experience, including experience with fashion, footwear, handbags, accessories or fashion e-commerce.
li
Proven ability to take marketing activity from planning and briefing through execution and reporting.
li
Strong understanding of brand positioning, tone of voice and consistent customer communication.
li
A strong eye for imagery, design and presentation, with the ability to give clear, useful creative feedback.
li
Excellent English writing, editing and proofreading skills; Arabic copywriting is a strong advantage.
li
Experience planning social media content, including Instagram and TikTok, and coordinating marketing across website, email and WhatsApp channels.
li
Ability to interpret social media and website analytics and connect marketing activity with engagement, traffic, conversion and sales.
li
Strong organisation, attention to detail and independent follow-through across multiple tasks and deadlines.
li
Understanding of Qatar or GCC fashion customers is an advantage.
li
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
r: li
Develop monthly marketing plans and weekly action calendars aligned with business priorities, customer interests and product availability.
li
Maintain and apply brand guidelines covering tone of voice, key messages and visual presentation across social media, the website, advertising, email and WhatsApp.
li
Write, edit and proofread marketing copy, including captions, headlines, product stories and customer messages.
li
Develop content ideas and clear creative briefs for designers, photographers, videographers and content creators; review work and follow revisions through to completion.
li
Plan and coordinate marketing activity around new arrivals, restocks, product highlights and brand stories.
li
Review social profiles, bios, highlights, message templates and other customer-facing materials; identify inconsistencies and coordinate improvements.
li
Work with the e-commerce team on messaging and creative assets for website banners, landing pages, email and WhatsApp communications.
li
Collaborate with the advertising specialist on campaign concepts, creative requirements and consistent messaging.
li
Research competitors, fashion trends, customer preferences and feedback, turning findings into practical marketing improvements.
li
Identify suitable influencers, creators and partnership opportunities; coordinate approved collaborations and assess results.
li
Track delivery, approvals and deadlines, and report on content and campaign performance with clear recommendations for improvement.
x: Apply through LinkedIn or send your CV to career@arkanmktg.com with the subject line Marketing Specialist.
